svg.title: Alphonso Braga, full-stack engineer
svg.desc: A mechanical drill worm bursts out of the ground, arcs over the name and stats, and burrows back down. 63 projects, 33 running live, 18 backends, 9 languages.

g.text: OPEN TO FREELANCE, CONTRACT AND FULL-TIME WORK
Full-stack engineer. I write the interface, the service
behind it and the schema under that.
